newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal closing economic gap with EU partners.
newsitem.headline: Portugal closing economic gap with EU partners.

text.p: Portugal is closing the economic gap on its richer European Union partners, with per capita income likely to reach 74 percent of the EU average by the year 2000, according to an EU report issued on Thursday.
The report, covering the impact of European structural funds received by Portugal in 1989-1993 and 1994-99, said the gap stood at 67 percent in 1993.
The report said that around 40 percent of this improvement in living standards could be attributed to the funds, which between 1994 and 1999 should boost economic output by 0.7 percent a year.
Portugal is due to receive 3.47 trillion escudos of structural adjustment funds from Brussels in the current four-year period.
